content.content: When invoked as `deccy remove` with an argument the form does not name — an argument shaped like a flag, or a second id — the deccy CLI shall refuse the invocation, naming the argument.
content.rationale: The form names exactly one `<id>` and no flags, so an argument beyond it names nothing `remove` can honour; guessing at it would abandon changes from an invocation the caller did not write. Naming the argument keeps the refusal actionable without re-deciding the form.
